retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1960s cinematic layout featuring a deep-focus interior shot with a prominent foreground element partially obscuring the view of a central figure, paired with right-aligned, bold sans-serif typography.
excludeWhen: serif or decorative script fonts are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A composition defined by a high-contrast foreground element (a leg in a stocking) cutting horizontally across the lower third, creating a frame-within-a-frame for a standing male figure in the background. The scene is set in a brightly lit, white-walled interior with architectural details like shutters and doors, while the top right quadrant is reserved for dense, right-aligned typographic blocks.
coreVisualRelationships: The horizontal foreground element creates a voyeuristic tension with the vertical subject.
The right-aligned text block balances the visual weight of the subject on the left.
The architectural lines of the door and shutters provide a geometric grid for the composition.
The muted, warm tones of the clothing contrast against the sterile white background.
coreInvariants: Foreground obstruction in the lower third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a standing male figure, medium-full shot, positioned in the left-center background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal foreground leg acts as the primary anchor and framing device.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the foreground leg, moves up to the subject's face, and then follows the horizontal lines to the text block in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space is created by the white walls and doors, providing a clean canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and cream (background walls and doors)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Tan and light blue (subject's jacket and shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value (brightness), creating a soft, slightly overexposed vintage look.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard mid-century grotesque forms

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over negative space of the wall

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and sizes of the same sans-serif family to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Small rectangular logo blocks in the top left corner
Dotted lines or thin rules for secondary metadata

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, mid-century grotesque feel and tight spacing.
Provides the necessary clean, neutral, and modern look of the era.
Offers a slightly more condensed and industrial feel common in 60s posters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a 1960s interior with white doors and shutters. A man in a tan corduroy jacket and blue shirt stands in the background. In the extreme foreground, a leg in a sheer stocking is blurred and cuts horizontally across the lower third of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned, all-caps bold sans-serif text in the upper right quadrant. Use black ink. Include smaller metadata text in the top left corner within small rectangular frames.

verificationChecks: Is the foreground element partially obscuring the subject?
Is the font a bold, clean sans-serif?
Is the color palette muted and vintage?

adjustableVariables: Foreground object type (while maintaining the horizontal obstruction)
Specific text content in the upper right
Intensity of the vintage film grain
mustRedesign: Any modern logos or brand names

avoid: Modern font choices like Calibri or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the foreground leg does not look anatomically distorted.
Verify the text does not overlap with the subject's face.
Check that the 'Stereo' or logo blocks in the corner are generic and not trademarked.
Confirm the right-alignment of the main text block is consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Cinematic Voyeuristic Framing] with [Right-Aligned Bold Grotesque Typography] over a [High-Key Mid-Century Interior] background.
